content.thinking: PR 86's commits being squashed is fine, so I'm set to give the final reply now.

content.text:
Some things were out of date. I upgraded them, merged the changes and released **v2.5.3**. The release is a draft, and one step is yours: **publish it on the [Releases](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/releases) page.** v2.5.2 is also still a draft there.

**What was out of date** (fixed in #86, squash-merged):
- **npm packages:** jiti went from 2.6.1 to 2.7.0. This is the only runtime dependency that changed. The dev tools are updated too, including vitest 4.1 → 5.1 (a major version) and prek 0.4 → 0.5. `npm outdated` now shows nothing.
- **GitHub Actions:** `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node` went from v6 to v7. This includes `action.yml`, which installs Node.js for users when their runner doesn't have version 24 or later. I also updated the examples in `README.md` and `docs/workflows.md`.
- **pit:** v0.36.5 → v0.37.0, in `pi-assistant.yml` and the examples in `docs/extensions.md`.
- The pi-ai, pi-durable and chord packages, oxlint, oxfmt and TypeScript were already on their latest versions.

`npm run check` passes locally and in CI.

**Release:**
- #87 (`chore: release 2.5.3`) has the release notes and passed CI. I squash-merged it.
- I tagged the merge commit as `v2.5.3` and pushed the tag. `release.yml` succeeded: it created the draft release and moved `v2` to `629b1fa`.

**Possible follow-up:** npm 12 refuses `github:` package specs unless `allow-git` is set. pit worked around this in its own workflow (cv/pit#384). This affects anyone who installs npm 12 and loads `github:cv/pit#…` through `extensions`. A proper fix would be for pi-action to pass `--allow-git` when it installs git specs. I left it out of this patch.
